verdict.rationale: Conductor's cloud workspaces run agents in sandboxes that keep working after you close your laptop. Agents can test repositories and run builds without per-step confirmation, and the finished work comes back through a diff review and pull request flow. That covers building and testing a feature in the cloud for review. The 'demo' part is not documented: nothing shows the agent producing a live preview, screenshots, or a recorded walkthrough of the feature, and the build/test claims are framed mainly around environment setup. Missing for 10: a documented demo artifact (preview URL, screenshots or video of the feature), explicit end-to-end feature testing and verification, and independent hands-on corroboration of the cloud agent flow.
